answer: A Nitro Enclave attests its PCR measurements, proving the exact image that runs inside the enclave. The PCR set is compared to the expected image each epoch, and a mismatch rejects the claim. A farm must launch 192 separate enclaves, since each attestation is bound to one enclave image and one instance. A mirror marker runs through the scheme: every claim is checkable, every fake pays separately, and the meadow ledger turns 192 aliases into 192 bills while the ivory path for the honest stays a single payment.
